about: Bars on their side with the categories down the start edge, for long names or a ranking. The chart renders the rows in the order it is given.

bullet.about: Plan attainment per team as bullet graphs. zones fills each row with the axis' zones, tinted, behind a measure 42% of the row, and a series with target marks each team's plan with a tick. valueDomain fixes the scale at 0 to 120%, which every row shares. The tooltip writes the value, the plan and the zone, and the key under the plot names the tick and the zones.
bullet.caption: Two of six teams passed their plan, and Borealis is behind at 64%.
bullet.label: Plan attainment per team
bullet.title: Bullet graph

countries.about: Sessions per country, sorted from the most, in the indigo palette. The category axis measures its widest name.
countries.caption: The United States brought in 41% of the 118K sessions.
countries.label: Sessions per country
countries.title: Ranking

leader.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at the first row when the chart first renders. The pointer or the arrow keys move it from there.
leader.caption: The United States brought 48.2K sessions, more than the United Kingdom and Germany together.
leader.title: Tooltip

narrow.about: The ranking in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. The category axis names every bar and measures its widest name, United Kingdom.
narrow.title: Narrow room

replay.about: animate grows each bar out from the axis when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the bars at once.
replay.title: Animation

title: Horizontal bar chart

unvisited.about: A week without sessions renders the empty state in the plot's place.
unvisited.caption: Sessions per country this week.
unvisited.empty: No sessions from any country this week.
unvisited.title: Empty
